name: Super Bakers (India) Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1978, Super Bakers (India) manufacturers bread and its varieties under brand name ‘Super Bread’.
keyPoints:
License:[1]
Company is a license holder of Modern Food Enterprises Pvt. Ltd. i.e. franchise of ‘Modern Bread’ for manufacturing & marketing in Gujarat and some parts of Rajasthan.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 7.79% over last 3 years.
